I replied in #central-team, in the thread under Pree's message. I could not confirm the 8 April date.

- **What I found:** The knowledge brain has no confirmed renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. Its notes put the account with the North team, and Marcus Lindqvist took it over in September 2025. That may be out of date.
- **What I told Pree:** I can't confirm or rule out the overheard date. She should ask Marcus, or check the signed order form with June Osei-Lark on the deal desk. I didn't repeat the date or share any renewal terms, since she isn't on the account team.
- **One slip:** I addressed her as "@Pree", which isn't her login (priyanka.sundaram). The posting tool can't edit or delete messages, so that stays. It may not notify her.

I didn't search channel history beyond the brain, and I didn't check the calendar or mail. The brain search is keyword-only, so a missed match is possible.
